description: Resolved identity snapshot for one production job (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task N). Built once from the identity policy and the authorized registries, stored on the job record (job['identity_snapshot']) so the production store persists it with the job. Later registry changes must not silently mutate an approved snapshot: reference hashes are revalidated on resume, and a missing asset or hash mismatch stops the job and is reported. No private media bytes, no credentials, no raw private paths in public Git — only asset ids, relative pointers and hashes.

approval_records.description: Approval events that authorize this snapshot (policy approval, per-job override approval).

cast_classes.description: Cast classification derived at bundle time (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task D): one entry per script character, character_ref to VISIBLE_CHARACTER / OFF_SCREEN_SPEAKER / NARRATOR_OR_VOICE_OVER / MENTIONED_ONLY. The compiler uses the analysis resolutions first and falls back to this list, so a non-visible cast member never receives an image/video binding. A free-form map is not used: the repo's schema style requires every object schema to carry non-empty properties with additionalProperties false.

identity_lock_version.description: Version of the identity lock for this job (starts at 1; a new explicit approval that changes the selection bumps it).

mode.description: The identity-selection mode this snapshot was resolved under.

registry_snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the registry records this snapshot was built from (sorted by character id). A later registry change produces a different hash.

registry_snapshot_version.description: Opaque version label of the registry state this snapshot was built from.

resolved_characters.description: Every character resolved for this job, registered and task-local, each with its approved reference data frozen at snapshot time.

cast_class.description: VISIBLE_CHARACTER: appears on screen. OFF_SCREEN_SPEAKER: speaks but never appears. NARRATOR_OR_VOICE_OVER: narration only. MENTIONED_ONLY: named but never seen or heard.

character_id.description: Registered character id, or null for a task-local character.

character_ref.description: How the script refers to this character.

fixed_identity_reference.description: Reference to the fixed identity instruction (prompt-block digest or the fixed_identity record hash). The approved reference is never silently replaced by a generated interpretation.

fixed_prompt_block.description: The fixed identity prompt block text for this character, copied from the registry record at snapshot time (private job-local state only; never published in public reports).

ownership_scope.description: Owner/workspace scope the character was resolved under.

primary_reference_id.description: Asset id of the primary (front-facing) identity reference.

proposal_id.description: Task-local proposal id, for task-local resolutions.

reference_asset_ids.description: Approved reference asset ids for this character (canonical front, three-quarter, full-body, detail). Each entry is an asset reference, never an embedded binary.

registry_record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the registry record this snapshot was built from. A changed record produces a different hash.

registry_record_version.description: Version of the registry record this snapshot was built from.

wardrobe_constraints.description: Approved wardrobe constraints for this character in this job.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this snapshot without the snapshot_hash field itself. A snapshot whose recomputed hash differs was tampered with.

voice_selections.description: Voice profile selected for each speaking character.
